title: Exponents and Exponential Growth
summary: Powers as repeated multiplication, and how doubling grows astonishingly fast: fold paper to the Moon!

cbse.chapter: Earlier NCERT Ch 11: Exponents and Powers

objectives: I can write and evaluate powers.
I can explain how repeated doubling grows.
I can compare powers and spot patterns in their last digits.
misconceptions: Doubling something 40 times makes it about 80 times bigger.
A negative base to any power is negative.
